reconstruction_strategy: Clean-Room WebRTC Implementation with REA-driven Protocol Parity

obligations.title: Room Creation, Validation & Peer Join Flow
obligations.target_behavior: Client requests room access with room ID (e.g. xxx-yyyy-zzz), signaling server tracks room participants, emits peer joined events, and maintains participant directory.
obligations.evidence: server/index.js: join-room event with room Map state and member broadcast

obligations.title: SDP Offer / Answer & ICE Candidate Relay
obligations.target_behavior: WebRTC session negotiation via WebSocket/Socket.io relay exchanging JSEP SDP descriptions and STUN ICE candidates between peers.
obligations.evidence: server/index.js: offer, answer, ice-candidate socket handlers

obligations.title: MediaStream Acquisition & Device Permissions
obligations.target_behavior: Acquire user audio and video tracks via navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with fallback handling for permission denial.
obligations.evidence: client/src/hooks/useWebRTC.js: getMediaStream with echoCancellation and noiseSuppression

obligations.title: STUN NAT Traversal & Multi-Peer Connection Mesh
obligations.target_behavior: Configures Google's public STUN server (stun.l.google.com:19302) to establish direct P2P audio/video media streams across NATs.

obligations.title: Mute/Unmute & Camera Track Toggle
obligations.target_behavior: Client enables/disables MediaStreamTrack without renegotiating the peer connection; notifies other peers to update their UI indicator.

obligations.title: Screen Sharing Integration
obligations.target_behavior: Acquires screen track via navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia and replaces video sender tracks in RTCPeerConnection.

obligations.title: Google Meet Dark Theme & Control Bar
obligations.target_behavior: Authentic bottom pill controls (mic, camera, captions/screen, chat, participants, leave call button) with clock and meeting code banner.

obligations.title: Adaptive Participant Video Grid
obligations.target_behavior: Dynamic grid layout automatically scaling 1, 2, 3, 4, 6+ participants with user avatars when video is off and active speaker indicators.

obligations.title: Pre-Join Lobby (Green Room)
obligations.target_behavior: User checks camera preview, tests mic/camera toggle, sets display name, and enters or generates room code before joining.

obligations.title: In-Meeting Realtime Chat & Participant List
obligations.target_behavior: Slide-out panel for participant roster and real-time chat broadcast during the call.
